div.head: CHn cor 4.2
div.ab: Et præcipio ut barones mei similiter se contineant erga filios et filias uel uxores hominum suorum.
Et praecipio ut barones mei similiter se contineant erga filios et filias vel uxores hominum suorum.
And I enjoin upon my barons to act with like moderation towards the sons and daughters and the wives of their vassals.
